skills.name: async-blocking-lint
skills.description: Detect synchronous network / IO calls (requests, urllib, httpx (sync mode), time.sleep, smtplib, paramiko) inside `async def` functions or coroutines. skills.incident: An async FastAPI service blocked the event loop with a `requests.post()` inside an `async def` handler. Under burst load (incoming voice calls triggering webhooks) the event loop stalled and the entire process queued up requests, eventually…
skills.incident_full: An async FastAPI service blocked the event loop with a `requests.post()` inside an `async def` handler. Under burst load (incoming voice calls triggering webhooks) the event loop stalled and the entire process queued up requests, eventually timing out. Replacing one synchronous call with `httpx.AsyncClient` cut p95 latency by an order of magnitude. This linter catches the pattern before it ships.
when_to_use: Writes an `async def` route handler or service method
Reviews FastAPI / Starlette / Litestar / aiohttp code
Mentions slow response times under load, server stalls, or "event loop blocked"
Asks about `asgi`, `async`, `await`, or coroutines in a server context
Uses `requests`, `urllib`, `httpx.Client` (sync), `time.sleep` in async code
